subject: Real 379MB repair-manual W1 build reaches durable draft_ready: terminal gate reconciles failed sections and a validated job is retryable without re-extraction

real_run.source: SY215C_SY021NCB62788_维修手册_zh.pdf (379MB) -> 2240 fixed plan sources
real_run.coverage_reconciliation: 2223 unique source_uris covered by 2240 per-(source,chunk) receipts + 17 failed sections = 2240 fixed sources; 2240 receipts <= limits.model_calls 5120

defect_I095.mechanism: jobs.py terminal draft_ready gate (a) capped len(drafts) at a hardcoded 512, unsatisfiable for a 2240-source plan whose per-(source,chunk) receipt array is 2240; and (b) required set(receipt.source_uri) == all fixed sources, but a section that exhausts its retries records a failure count instead of a receipt, so 17 sources were legitimately uncovered and the equality could never hold
defect_I095.symptom: job failed at wiki_validate with 'Private candidate receipt must cover every fixed source' after a full, correct extraction
fix: openviking/indexing/jobs.py: cap = config.limits.model_calls (scales with the plan; every receipt costs >=1 call) instead of a fixed 512
openviking/wiki/extraction.py: terminal receipt now carries failed_sources (sorted URIs that exhausted retries) alongside the existing failed_sections counts

openviking/indexing/jobs.py: coverage reconciled as receipts UNION failed_sources == fixed sources; a receipt written before failed_sources existed is reconciled by count — (len(sources) - len(covered)) == sum(failed_sections.values())

defect_I096.mechanism: a W1 job that reached wiki_validate but failed the durable terminal gate (or lost its worker) was unretryable: extract_wiki re-enters wiki_extract on every run, but the stage machine forbade the wiki_validate -> wiki_extract rewind ('Job checkpoint cannot skip or rewind stages'); and the wiki_validate checkpoint stored only {draft_receipt, diagnostic_published}, dropping extraction_progress, so even a permitted retry would re-extract all 2240 sources from scratch (~6.7h of model calls) despite a complete, durable, content-addressed receipt already existing
fix: openviking/indexing/jobs.py: permit the single wiki_validate -> wiki_extract rewind for W1/W2; the terminal gate, not the stage counter, is the authority on receipt validity, so no integrity check is weakened

openviking/service/kb_job_runtime.py: when the checkpoint already holds a complete draft_receipt (state=draft_ready, private, diagnostic_publishable False, build_id/plan_digest match, extractor_version/policy_version/model_profile/limits match the live extractor), re-authorize and re-commit that exact receipt through the existing replay loop instead of re-running extraction
defect_I096.salvage_cost: requeued job resumed from the durable receipt and committed draft_ready in ~30s wall clock with zero model calls (2240 blob re-reads + policy recheck), versus a ~6.7h full re-extraction

observations.security_note: Re-committing a prior receipt does not bypass any gate: the replay loop still re-runs authorize_inputs, re-reads every content-addressed candidate blob under current contributor permissions (read_draft_payload), and rechecks the namespace policy; job_complete then re-validates authorization_revision against the live kb_policy_revisions, per-receipt sha256/size blob references, coverage, and effective configuration. The receipt's authorization_revision (18) matched the live policy revision (18) at commit.
observations.http_publish_chain: GET /api/v1/kb/wiki/jobs/27bebf83411d4010845d8e62191d09fe/drafts/0 with the runtime-only flowadmin tenant key returned 200 and real repair-manual candidates (e.g. Source_PDF_image_page_1000_placement_1.md with verbatim quote/claim evidence and SHA-256 99a3a0d3...); the private candidate tree is readable post-draft_ready and diagnostic_publishable stays False

unit: tests/enterprise_kb/test_wiki_execution_jobs.py::test_terminal_gate_reconciles_coverage_with_failed_sources — covered={ONE}, failed_sources=[TWO]; unaccounted (failed_sources=[]) raises 'must cover every fixed source', accounted receipt completes to draft_ready
tests/enterprise_kb/test_wiki_execution_jobs.py (6 passed), tests/enterprise_kb/test_durable_jobs.py (19 passed) — 25 passed with the I095/I096 gate + stage changes
tests.live: job 27bebf83411d4010845d8e62191d09fe reached state=draft_ready (attempt 18) on the real 2240-source manual and serves drafts over HTTP

truthful_boundaries: This closes W1 extraction to a durable private draft_ready terminal. Downstream publication_pending gates remain unmet and out of scope here: semantic_evidence_validation, schema_identity_resolution, trusted_entity_catalog, closed_relationships, derived_access_intersection, atomic_joint_publication.

17 of 2240 sections did not produce a candidate (2 EVIDENCE_MISSING, 3 MODEL_TIMEOUT, 12 SCHEMA_VIOLATION); they are reconciled as accounted failures, not silently dropped, and are not retried within this build.

The legacy count-based reconciliation branch was exercised by the live receipt (which predates failed_sources); the exact failed_sources branch is covered by unit test but not yet by a fresh live run.
